summary: Code quality is high: PowerShell follows best practices (Set-StrictMode, strict error handling, param validation, -Force module load). Workflow structure is sound (least-privilege permissions, job deps, proper pwsh shell config, semantic env vars). However, deliverable is incomplete and non-functional. Critical failures: (1) PrLabelAssigner.Tests.ps1 referenced in workflow but missing—workflow will fail immediately. (2) Fixtures (fixtures/changed-files.txt, config/labels.json) missing, script cannot run. (3) act-result.txt artifact required by task absent. (4) TDD requirement unverifiable (tests should exist per task §1-3). (5) No actionlint or act validation shown. Task requires all tests run via act with artifact proof; delivery lacks all test infrastructure. Cannot ship without these required components.
